name: biookf
description: BioOKF: create, curate, query, revise, merge, visualize, and analyze biomedical Open Knowledge Format bundles from Codex, including local subscription workflows and network metrics.

interface.shortDescription: Curate and visualize biomedical knowledge bases.
interface.longDescription: BioOKF gives Codex MCP tools, CLI workflows, and BioOKF Studio for Paperclip and local-resource generation, grounded chat, evidence-backed Doctor revisions, semantic merging, validation, topology metrics, and source-year evidence timelines.
defaultPrompt: Open BioOKF Studio and inspect the active knowledge base.
Ingest this review into a BioOKF bundle with provenance.
Verify this BioOKF bundle and fix every error.
